newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS THURSDAY MIXED ON UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS THURSDAY MIXED ON UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar ended Thursday's fairly quiet interbank session firmer on the U.S. dollar and the rand, but was quoted easier against sterling and the mark.

Dealers said although there was no undue import pressure on the currency during the day, the central Reserve Bank came in to inject a few U.S. dollars into the market, pushing the local dollar up from its morning levels.
"I think they want to see our dollar holding around the 10.8300 Level. The moment it goes below that they're coming in," commented one.
The Zimbabwe dollar, which hit 10.8400/8550 against the U.S. unit in the morning, closed on Thursday at 10.8250/8400. This compared with 10.8350/8550 at the last close.

Against the crosses, it was quoted at 18.4300/4500 versus sterling, slightly up from 18.5600/5800 earlier, but a drop from 18.4000/4200 when trade ended on Tuesday. It finished at 6.9900/7.0100 against the mark, down from Tuesday's 6.9700/9900.
Against the rand however, the Zimbabwe currency edged up to 2.3000/3200 from 2.3100/3300.
